profile.heading: Profile
profile.description: Update your personal information and display preferences.

security.heading: Security
security.description: Manage your account security settings and two-factor authentication.

mfa.title: Two-Factor Authentication
mfa.description: Add an extra layer of security to your account by requiring a verification code in addition to your password.
mfa.setupDescription: Scan the QR code below with your authenticator app (e.g., Google Authenticator, Authy, or 1Password), then enter the 6-digit code to verify.
mfa.enabledDescription: Your account is now protected with two-factor authentication.
mfa.enabledPrompt: You will be asked for a verification code when signing in.
mfa.cantScanQr: Can't scan the QR code? Enter this key manually:
mfa.verifyPrompt: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to complete setup:
mfa.backupCodesDescription: These codes can be used to access your account if you lose your authenticator device. Each code can only be used once. Store them in a safe place.
mfa.copyAllLabel: Copy all backup codes to clipboard
mfa.downloadLabel: Download backup codes as text file
mfa.disableDescription: This will remove the extra layer of security from your account. Enter your password to confirm.

benefits.title: Two-factor authentication (2FA) helps protect your account by:
benefits.requireCode: Requiring a time-based code from your authenticator app at sign-in
benefits.preventUnauthorized: Preventing unauthorized access even if your password is compromised
benefits.backupCodes: Providing backup codes for account recovery if you lose your device

mfa.qrAlt: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app to set up two-factor authentication
